facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mr. McGregor chased Peter. 😡 Peter was scared. 😱 He found a place to hide. He hid quickly. 🙈

Mr. McGregor walked right past without seeing him. He hid quickly and stayed very still. 🙈
